versos.texto_bv: Junto ao portão do acampamento, Moisés tomou posição e gritou: “Quem pertence ao SENHOR, venha para o meu lado!” Todos os levitas se juntaram a ele.
versos.traducao_literal: E ficou de pé Moisés na entrada do acampamento, e disse: “Quem para YHWH? A mim!” E reuniram-se a ele todos os filhos de Levi.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): BV usa “gritou” onde o original (וַיֹּאמֶר, vayomer) e a traducao_literal dizem “disse”. “Gritou” adiciona intensidade/modo não presente no texto fonte; NTLH/ARA/NVIPT convergem em “disse”. — evidência: traducao_literal: “e disse”; NTLH “disse”; ARA “disse”; NVIPT “disse”. Corrigir de “gritou” para “disse” é mudança semântica (redução de intensidade do modo verbal) — excede o escopo de revisão de forma.

kjv.texto: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the Lord’s side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.

vizinhos.25: And when Moses saw that the people were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:)
vizinhos.27: And he said unto them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Put every man his sword by his side, and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.

web.texto: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, “Whoever is on Yahweh’s side, come to me!”   All the sons of Levi gathered themselves together to him.

vizinhos.25: When Moses saw that the people had broken loose, (for Aaron had let them loose for a derision among their enemies),
vizinhos.27: He said to them, “Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, ‘Every man put his sword on his thigh, and go back and forth from gate to gate throughout the camp, and every man kill his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbor.’”
